Nepal Floods Damage Infrastructure, Five Reported Missing

Heavy rainfall has caused floods in Nepal, damaging bridges and hydropower projects in the Gorkha district. Five people are reported missing. Authorities are urging villagers to evacuate as floodwaters rush through communities, prompting rescue helicopters to be deployed.
